users.description: Create and manage the people who can send files. There is no public registration.

fields.displayNameHelp: Shown to people who receive their files instead of the email address.
fields.passwordHelp: At least {{count}} characters. Leave it empty to let the user choose it.
fields.quotaHelp: Leave empty for no quota: only the free disk space limits uploads.
fields.disabledHelp: A disabled user is signed out and cannot sign in.

errors.displayNameTooLong: The display name is too long (80 characters at most).
errors.passwordTooShort: The password is too short (at least 12 characters).
errors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (128 characters at most).
errors.quotaInvalid: Enter a number greater than zero, or leave the field empty.

create.title: New user
create.description: The user will be able to sign in and send files.
create.welcomeNote: No password set: the user will receive a welcome email with a link, valid for 72 hours, to choose their password.
create.createdWelcomeToast: User created. A welcome email was sent to {{email}}.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.selfLocked: You cannot change your own role or disable your own account.

reset2fa.title: Reset two-factor authentication?
reset2fa.descriptionUser: {{email}} will be signed out and will be able to sign in with the password only. They can enable 2FA again from their profile.
reset2fa.descriptionAdmin: {{email}} will be signed out and will have to set up 2FA again the next time they sign in: administrators cannot work without it.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.question: What should happen to their transfers and files?
delete.modeDeleteHelp: Links stop working immediately and the files are removed from the disk.
delete.modeReassignHelp: Transfers, uploads and the storage they use pass to the chosen user.
delete.targetRequired: Choose the user who will receive the transfers.
delete.irreversible: The account is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

transfers.description: Transfers of all users. Open one to manage it.

storage.description: Disk space and how much each user is using.
storage.freeNote: Free space {{free}}; reserve kept for the system {{reserve}}.

settings.description: General options, outgoing email and public address.

general.title: General
general.description: Limits that apply to every upload and the default language of the instance.
general.diskReserveHelp: Free space that uploads never use. 0 disables the reserve.
general.chunkSizeHelp: From 1 to {{max}} MB. Behind Cloudflare no request may exceed 100 MB, so the default of 25 MB is a safe choice.
general.defaultLocaleHelp: Used for emails to recipients and for visitors without a preference.

errors.reserve: Enter a whole number of MB, from 0 to 10485760.
errors.chunk: Enter a whole number of MB, from 1 to 50.

general.updateCheckHelp: Once a day the server asks GitHub for the latest published version. No data about the instance is sent.

smtp.title: Outgoing email (SMTP)
smtp.description: Used for download notifications, welcome and password reset emails. Send a test email before saving.
smtp.passwordKept: A password is saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.
smtp.testFirst: Send a test email with these values to enable saving. Any change requires a new test.
smtp.testOk: Test email sent to {{email}}. Check your inbox, then save.
smtp.testFailedReason: The test email could not be sent (code {{reason}}). Check the server, port, security and credentials.

errors.host: Enter the mail server address (255 characters at most).
errors.fromEmail: Enter a valid sender email address.
errors.fromName: The sender name is too long (100 characters at most).

tunnel.title: Domain and tunnel
tunnel.description: The public address of the instance, served through a Cloudflare tunnel.
tunnel.localTitle: Cloudflare is not used in local mode
tunnel.localBody: This instance runs with APP_MODE=local, so there is no tunnel and no public domain. The form is disabled.
tunnel.domainHelp: A domain managed by your Cloudflare account, for example example.com.
tunnel.subdomainHelp: For example “send” for send.example.com. Empty uses the domain itself.
tunnel.apiTokenHelp: Used only for this operation: it is never saved.
tunnel.permissionsTitle: Create the token with these minimal permissions
tunnel.createToken: Open the Cloudflare API tokens page
tunnel.reconfigureWarning: Changing the domain changes the public address: links already shared with the old address will stop working.

errors.domain: Enter a valid domain, for example example.com.
errors.subdomain: Use only letters, numbers and hyphens.
errors.token: Enter the Cloudflare API token (at least 20 characters).

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The version you are running and the latest version published on GitHub.
updates.disabledHint: Turn on “Check for updates” in the General section to know when a new version is released.
updates.unavailableHint: The server could not read the latest version. Try again later.
updates.devBuild: This instance runs version “{{version}}”, which is not a release number: it is not compared with published versions.
updates.howBody: On the server that hosts EasySend run these commands. The deploy pulls the new images, takes a backup and restarts the stack.
updates.commands: Commands to run on the server

oneClick.confirmBody: EasySend will be unreachable for a few minutes while it restarts. A database backup is taken first, and if the update fails the instance goes back to the current version automatically.
oneClick.missingBody: Install the update service on the server once to update from this page. Run this in the install folder:
oneClick.installCommands: Commands to install the update service

steps.health: Checking that the new version responds
steps.rollback: Going back to the previous version

oneClick.restarting: Restarting… this page reconnects by itself.
oneClick.signedOut: Your session ended during the update. Sign in again to see the result.
oneClick.staleTitle: The update service is not responding
oneClick.staleBody: The request was sent but the server has not picked it up. On the server check the service and its log:
oneClick.staleCommands: Commands to check the update service
oneClick.succeededBody: The new version is running. Reload the page to load the new interface.
oneClick.rolledBackBody: The instance went back to {{from}} and its data was restored from the backup taken before the update. The log is on the server at:

failed.busy: Another deploy was already running on the server, so nothing was changed.
failed.invalid_request: The server rejected the update request, so nothing was changed.
failed.compose: The release files could not be downloaded, so nothing was changed.
failed.backup: The database backup failed, so nothing was changed.
failed.deploy: The new version did not start correctly.
failed.rollback_failed: The update failed and the automatic rollback did not complete. Check the server with `docker compose ps` and read the log.

appearance.description: Name, colours, font and images of the public pages and of the emails. Changes apply to every page after you save.
appearance.resetDescription: Name, footer, colours, radius, font and theme go back to the {{name}} defaults. The uploaded logos, favicon and background are removed too.

errors.instanceName: Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters.
errors.footer: The footer is too long (200 characters at most).
errors.color: Enter a colour as #rrggbb, for example #047857.

fields.title: Identity and style
fields.instanceNameHelp: Shown in the header, in the emails and as the sender on the download page when a user has no display name.
fields.footerHelp: Shown at the bottom of public pages and emails. Leave it empty to hide the footer.
fields.radiusHelp: In rem. The interface uses square corners, so the effect is limited; the value is used by the emails.
fields.defaultThemeHelp: Each user can choose their own in their profile.

images.title: Images
images.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{size}} each. SVG is not accepted. Images are re-encoded and resized; the change is applied immediately.
images.removeDescription: The default image will be used again.

help.logoLight: Recommended: transparent background, up to 800×200 px. Also used in the emails.
help.logoDark: Recommended: version for dark backgrounds, up to 800×200 px. If missing, the light logo is used.
help.background: Recommended: up to 2560×1440 px, low detail so the text stays readable.

errors.type: Unsupported format. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.size: The file is too large: the maximum is {{max}}.
